descriptions.zh: 对§Y[this.GetName]§!的初步扫描发现了一个特殊的空中物体，漂浮在对流层中，随着位置的改变而涨缩。为探明其性质，需要进行进一步的调查。
descriptions.en: Initial scans of §Y[this.GetName]§! have discovered a peculiar airborne object floating through the troposphere, shrinking and swelling in size as it changes positions. Further investigation is necessary in order to classify its nature.

sections.zh: 对§Y[this.GetName]§!的初步扫描发现了一个特殊的空中物体，漂浮在对流层中，随着位置的改变而涨缩。为探明其性质，需要进行进一步的调查。
sections.en: Initial scans of §Y[this.GetName]§! have discovered a peculiar airborne object floating through the troposphere, shrinking and swelling in size as it changes positions. Further investigation is necessary in order to classify its nature.

descriptions.zh: 对§Y[from.GetName]§!地表的初步调查发现这里经常发生一种含有高浓度重金属的超热熔岩海啸。必须通过进一步分析才能完全理解这种现象。
descriptions.en: Initial surveys of §Y[from.GetName]'s§! surface have detected frequent tsunamis of superheated lava containing high concentrations of heavy metals. Further analysis will be necessary to fully understand this phenomenon.

sections.zh: 对§Y[from.GetName]§!地表的初步调查发现这里经常发生一种含有高浓度重金属的超热熔岩海啸。必须通过进一步分析才能完全理解这种现象。
sections.en: Initial surveys of §Y[from.GetName]'s§! surface have detected frequent tsunamis of superheated lava containing high concentrations of heavy metals. Further analysis will be necessary to fully understand this phenomenon.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!的地表分布着泾渭分明的两种色彩以极快的速度串联移动着，在太空中亦清晰可见。这些蓝色的结构相当有趣，值得进一步研究。
descriptions.en: The surface of §Y[from.GetName]§! features two distinctive discolorations, large enough to be visible from space and moving in tandem at great speeds. These blue-colored formations are interesting enough to warrant further study.

sections.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!的地表分布着泾渭分明的两种色彩以极快的速度串联移动着，在太空中亦清晰可见。这些蓝色的结构相当有趣，值得进一步研究。
sections.en: The surface of §Y[from.GetName]§! features two distinctive discolorations, large enough to be visible from space and moving in tandem at great speeds. These blue-colored formations are interesting enough to warrant further study.

descriptions.zh: 对§Y[from.GetName]§!的初步扫描发现在这颗冰冻的天体上存在极不正常的热量峰值。这种温度异常亟待进一步的调查。
descriptions.en: Initial scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! are showing extremely erratic heat spikes on this otherwise frozen celestial body. These anomalous temperatures elicit further investigation.

sections.zh: 对§Y[from.GetName]§!的初步扫描发现在这颗冰冻的天体上存在极不正常的热量峰值。这种温度异常亟待进一步的调查。
sections.en: Initial scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! are showing extremely erratic heat spikes on this otherwise frozen celestial body. These anomalous temperatures elicit further investigation.

descriptions.zh: 在§Y[from.GetName]§!的上层大气探测到了高浓度的毒性有机分子。
descriptions.en: High concentrations of organic poisonous molecules have been detected in the upper atmosphere of §Y[from.GetName]§!.

sections.zh: 在§Y[from.GetName]§!的上层大气探测到了高浓度的毒性有机分子。
sections.en: High concentrations of organic poisonous molecules have been detected in the upper atmosphere of §Y[from.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!外层气体的怪异活动打开了一些极深的开口，短暂地暴露出行星的固体核心。这一独特现象值得进一步研究。
descriptions.en: Strange movements in §Y[from.GetName]'s§! gassy outer layers are causing exceptionally deep vents to open up, exposing the planet's solid core in brief intervals. This remarkable phenomenon warrants further study.

sections.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!外层气体的怪异活动打开了一些极深的开口，短暂地暴露出行星的固体核心。这一独特现象值得进一步研究。
sections.en: Strange movements in §Y[from.GetName]'s§! gassy outer layers are causing exceptionally deep vents to open up, exposing the planet's solid core in brief intervals. This remarkable phenomenon warrants further study.

descriptions.zh: 对§Y[from.GetName]§!的影像扫描显示行星表面有极其活跃的光学现象，尽管这些颜色图案的成因在轨道距离上尚未探明。
descriptions.en: Our imaging scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! are returning extremely vibrant optical phenomena across the planet's surface, though the cause of these color patterns remains unclear at an orbital distance.

sections.zh: 对§Y[from.GetName]§!的影像扫描显示行星表面有极其活跃的光学现象，尽管这些颜色图案的成因在轨道距离上尚未探明。
sections.en: Our imaging scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! are returning extremely vibrant optical phenomena across the planet's surface, though the cause of these color patterns remains unclear at an orbital distance.

descriptions.zh:
我们目睹了敏感的超热等离子体喷发到§Y[from.GetName]§!的上层大气中。

大气层中浓厚的火山灰让我们无法从轨道上辨识这些喷射源，但近距离研究似乎存在危险。
descriptions.en:
We have visual confirmation of volatile superheated plasma being launched into the upper atmosphere of §Y[from.GetName]§!.

Thick volcanic ash in the atmosphere is preventing us from identifying the source of these projectiles from orbit. Closer study will likely be dangerous.

descriptions.zh: 在§Y[from.GetName]§!的大气中发现了浓厚的黑云，它们无视行星的风速和风向以极不正常的方式运动着。这些黑云只在我们的成像扫描中短暂出现，并且总是在行星昼夜周期的同一时间点上出现。
descriptions.en: Thick black clouds have been observed in §Y[from.GetName]'s§! atmosphere, moving in erratic patterns independent of planetary wind speed or direction. They appear only briefly on our imaging scans and always at the same point in the planet's day-night cycle.

sections.zh: 在§Y[from.GetName]§!的大气中发现了浓厚的黑云，它们无视行星的风速和风向以极不正常的方式运动着。这些黑云只在我们的成像扫描中短暂出现，并且总是在行星昼夜周期的同一时间点上出现。

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!的冰冻荒原之下潜藏着巨大的冰下海洋。在深深的永冻层下探测到的隆隆震动，从本质上无法被归类为地震。
descriptions.en: Beneath §Y[from.GetName]'s§! frozen and lifeless surface lies a vast subglacial ocean. Deep, rumbling vibrations have been detected beneath the permafrost that are not registering as seismic in nature.

sections.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!的冰冻荒原之下潜藏着巨大的冰下海洋。在深深的永冻层下探测到的隆隆震动，从本质上无法被归类为地震。
sections.en: Beneath §Y[from.GetName]'s§! frozen and lifeless surface lies a vast subglacial ocean. Deep, rumbling vibrations have been detected beneath the permafrost that are not registering as seismic in nature.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!的轨道扫描检测到这颗行星深深的冰洋之下有异常的电信号。

对这种水中自然现象进行进一步研究可以获得更多发现。
descriptions.en:
Orbital scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! are detecting erratic electrical signals deep within the planet's icy seas.

Further study into this aquatic phenomenon will reveal more.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!进行视觉扫描发现黑曜岩大陆板块覆盖着这颗行星贫瘠的表面，上层大气中残留着大量的硫。

专项地质调查将让我们得到更多结果。
descriptions.en:
Visual scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! show continental sheets of obsidian coating the barren surfaces of the planet, with heavy traces of sulfur lingering in the upper atmosphere.

A more concentrated geological survey will tell us more.

descriptions.zh:
释放到§Y[from.GetName]§!大气层中的探测器停止了一切通讯。我们失去了该硬件的行踪。

需要对该行星进行近距离调查才能取回这些数据。
descriptions.en:
Observation probes deployed into the atmosphere of §Y[from.GetName]§! have ceased all communications. The exact location of our hardware is now unknown.

A closer investigation of the planet is needed to recover the data.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!的质量读数远低于一颗同等尺寸岩质行星预期范围。建议进一步调查。
descriptions.en: Mass readings for §Y[from.GetName]§! are well below the expected range for a rocky planet of this size. Further investigation is recommended.

sections.en: Mass readings for §Y[from.GetName]§! are well below the expected range for a rocky planet of this size. Further investigation is recommended.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!被潮汐锁定了，有一半永远处于黑夜之中。红外扫描发现这片漆黑贫瘠的区域竟是某种活跃的有机生态系统所在。
descriptions.en: §Y[from.GetName]§! is tidally locked with one half of the planet existing in a state of permanent darkness. Infrared scans indicate that this lightless and nutrient deficient zone is home to an active organic ecosystem.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!的初步扫描发现，遍流行星表面的荧光河不停地在整个光谱中变化。

进一步的研究会加深我们对这个异常自然现象的了解。
descriptions.en:
Preliminary scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! show fluorescent rivers flowing across the planet's surface that continuously shift through the full range of the color spectrum.

Further study will tell us more about this unusual phenomenon.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!的大气主要由各种气态金属构成。进一步了解这颗行星的严苛条件后我们或许就能提取这些有价值的化合物。
descriptions.en: The atmosphere of §Y[from.GetName]§! is primarily composed of various metals in a gaseous state. With better understanding of this planet's harsh conditions we may be able to extract these valuable compounds.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!的波谱信号表明行星上的一种成分富含某种稀有而复杂的碳同素异形体。为了更彻底的分类，需要更仔细的检查。
descriptions.en: Spectroscopy data from §Y[from.GetName]§! indicates a planetary composition rich in rare and complex carbon allotropes. Closer inspection is required for more thorough categorization.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!的质量扫描发现对流层下层有大量快速移动的物质。

如果没有更详细的调查，这些异常读数的来源很难加以确认。
descriptions.en:
Mass scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! reveal high concentrations of fast moving physical matter located deep within the lower troposphere.

The source of these unusual readings is difficult to verify without further detailed investigation.

descriptions.zh: 对§Y[from.GetName]§!的地质扫描表明这颗熔融星球的地壳承受着非常巨大的构造应力。可能有重大的地质事件即将发生。
descriptions.en: Geological scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! suggest that the planetary crust of this molten world is under immense pressure from pent-up tectonic forces. A significant geological event may be imminent.

对§Y[from.GetName]§!的扫描发现可燃气体在整颗行星上零星喷发，给远程观测带来了挑战。

需要进行近距离调查。
descriptions.en:
Scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! have detected sporadic eruptions of combustible gases across the planet, presenting challenges for remote surveys.

A closer inspection will be needed.

descriptions.zh:
沿§Y[from.GetName]§!的构造断层线探测到了不稳定的能量波动。

这些波动的根源无法从轨道上加以确定。需要近距离研究才能弄清该现象的源头。
descriptions.en:
Erratic energy surges are being detected along the tectonic fault lines of §Y[from.GetName]§!.

The origin of these spikes cannot be ascertained from orbit. Closer study will be required to identify the source of this phenomenon.

descriptions.en: Tectonic analysis of §Y[from.GetName]§! shows significant cryovolcanic activity across the planet of an anomalous nature.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!是一颗超大质量气态巨行星，其强大的引力井将数千物体吸引到其轨道上。将其进行分类编目应该会很有价值。
descriptions.en: §Y[from.GetName]§! is a supermassive gas giant whose strong gravity well has swept thousands of objects into its orbit. Cataloging them may prove worthwhile.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!的轨道路径上有一个反复出现的微小震荡。这表明它有规律地受到某种大型未知引力的影响。

建议对其周边环境进行进一步研究。
descriptions.en:
A small but recurring oscillation has been observed in the orbit path of §Y[from.GetName]§!, suggesting it is regularly subjected to some large unknown gravitational force.

Further study of the surrounding space is recommended.

descriptions.zh: 对§Y[from.GetName]§!贫瘠地表的勘测显示出一个被改造的外勤站，这最初只是一座临时研究实验室，如今早已超出预期寿命。微弱的热辐射表明，该设施的部分区域依然处于活跃状态。
descriptions.en: Survey sweeps of §Y[from.GetName]'s§! barren surface have revealed a repurposed field station, originally a temporary research lab long past its intended lifespan. Faint heat radiation suggest parts of the installation remain active.

descriptions.zh:
对§H[from.GetName]§!的扫描显示了大面积快速迁移的高压力风暴。

这些风暴释放着极强的热信号。需要着重研究才能揭示该现象是自然发生或是由某种至今未知的生命形式引起。
descriptions.en:
Scans of §H[from.GetName]§! show vast swathes of rapidly migrating high-pressure storms.

These storms are emitting extremely volatile heat signatures. Focused research will be needed to reveal if the cause is natural or a hitherto unknown form of life.

需要进行近距离研究才能理解这一异常地理现象。
descriptions.en:
Scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! show sections of the molten planetary surface shifting continuously across large distances.

Closer study is required to understand this unusual geological phenomenon.

descriptions.en: Suspended within the upper atmosphere of §Y[from.GetName]§! is a series of large cylindrical machines. They appear inactive devoid of any crew.

sections.en: Suspended within the upper atmosphere of §Y[from.GetName]§! is a series of large cylindrical machines. They appear inactive devoid of any crew.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!环绕恒星的方向与恒星系内其他行星相反，这说明它和伴随的天体并不是同时同地形成的。

需要进一步调查来了解该行星的起源。
descriptions.en:
§Y[from.GetName]§! orbits its star in the reverse direction compared to the other planets in the system, suggesting it did not form here at the same time as its companion celestial bodies.

Further investigation is needed to understand this planet's origins.

descriptions.zh:
在§Y[from.GetName]§!的地表上观测到有成千上万的异常蒸汽羽状物升起，延伸到其稀薄大气的顶层。

建议对该现象进行深入调查。
descriptions.en:
Thousands of anomalous vapor plumes have been observed rising from the surface of §Y[from.GetName]§!, extending to the upper limits of its thin atmosphere.

Further investigation of this phenomenon is advised.

descriptions.zh: 对§Y[from.GetName]§!的初步扫描结果是损坏的，我们的仪器无法清晰解读。这一干扰的来源尚不明确；或许需要近距离调查 。
descriptions.en: Initial scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! are returning in a corrupted state that our sensors cannot clearly interpret. The source of this interference remains unclear; a closer inspection will be needed.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!的扫描追踪到了极端的气象现象，地表分布着零星但强烈的热脉冲。

需要进一步调查。
descriptions.en:
Scans of §Y[from.GetName]§! are tracking extreme meteorological phenomena, with sporadic but intense heat spikes distributed across the surface.

This warrants further investigation.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.GetName]§!的扫描显示这是一颗死亡行星，它曾经是气态巨行星，但大气层被§Y[from.System.Star.GetName]§!强烈的辐射剥离了。

尽管如此，它的地表上还是探测到了非常痕量的生物质，需要进一步调查。
descriptions.en:
Surveys of §Y[from.GetName]§! reveal it to be a chthonian planet, a former gas giant stripped of its atmosphere by the intense radiation of §Y[from.System.Star.GetName]§!.

Despite this, very faint traces of biomass have been detected on its surface, warranting further investigation.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.System.GetName]§!内的公转周期展现出了引人注目的规律。每颗环绕恒星的行星都以两倍其相邻行星的周期公转着，精确到千分之一秒。

这种怪异的精确比值值得调查。
descriptions.en:
Orbital durations in the §Y[from.System.GetName]§! system exhibit a remarkable pattern. Each planet orbits the star in exactly double the time of its neighbor, accurate to over a thousandth of a second.

This anomalously perfect ratio warrants investigation.
